notes:
- Company background: MarketLoop is a mid-market B2B SaaS marketplace search product (SaaS, 300 employees).
- Primary workload: product search and support assistant powered by embeddings + semantic reranking.
- Current infra: Postgres + nightly ETL -> S3 -> ingestion jobs that call hosted embedding endpoint. Evaluating whether to keep embeddings in Hosted API for fast time-to-value vs Dedicated for consistent throughput.
- POC goals: 2M historical rows batch embed in <=72h, sustained 100k embeddings/hour ingest, 99th pctile search latency <120ms for top-K queries including reranking stage, acceptable cost < $0.20 per 1k embeddings (target).
- Vector DB integration: testing with Pinecone (managed), Weaviate (cloud self-managed), and Milvus on EKS. Key concern: bulk upsert performance and shard sizing; want Redwood recommended best-practice connector + pagination strategy.
- Batch jobs: They run nightly backfills and periodic re-embeds when model updates happen; need tooling for incremental checkpointing, dedupe, and resumable jobs.
- Model preferences: open LLM embeddings first (e.g., Open-embedding-family), interested in quantized variants for Dedicated to save cost.
- Routing/fallback: want Hosted as primary during POC but need clear plan to flip to Dedicated with zero downtime; interested in canary + automatic fallback to smaller model when Dedicated capacity saturated.
- Security/compliance asks: SSO/SAML for user access into console, audit logs for all token-level usage, KMS integration for encryption keys, retention controls and data residency (US only for now).
- Quotes/highlights from call: "We need predictable ingest throughput for weekly marketing pushes — can't have burst throttles." / "If Dedicated gives consistent throughput and a migration path, we'll consider 12mo commit."
- Technical gaps: their ETL workers are memory constrained; Redwood suggested client-side batching and compression to reduce concurrent connections.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high — will trade some latency for lower unit cost but need firm SLA for peak windows.
- Docs & artifacts: POC plan in Drive, security answers attached, pricing deck v1 shared.
- Next technical asks: 1) provide sample batch-run config for 2M rows with estimated runtime on Hosted vs Dedicated; 2) whitepaper on vector DB connector performance tuning; 3) Dedicated latency SLO examples by model variant.
- Internal notes: prioritize answering security questionnaire and get SOC2 artifacts to CISO. SE to prepare throughput run checklist and runbook for move to Dedicated.
